Quest name: The Scale of the Night Sky (Chrono Quest - 3rd period, 18th Century)
Quest location: Amsterdam Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r5 Recognition, r7 Astronomy, SPA(Spanish)
Pre-requisite discovery: Virgo discovery (from "Goddess of the Ecliptic" quest) + Scorpio discovery (from "A Scorpion Which Shines to the Heavens" quest)
Additional notes: Part of 12 Zodiac Constellations
